slides.title: Myth: 'A place for everything.' Truth: our brains need fewer places.
Myth: every item gets a home
slides.body: Truth: 40 tiny homes means 40 things to remember. Fewer, bigger zones are easier to keep.

slides.title: Myth: labels fix it
slides.body: Truth: labels help only if the bin is in sight. A label in a closed cabinet is a secret.

slides.title: Myth: hide the clutter
slides.body: Truth: out of sight means gone forever. Open bins and clear fronts keep things findable.

slides.title: Myth: sort by category
slides.body: Truth: sort by where you use it. Scissors live by the mail, not in the 'office supplies' bin.

slides.title: My stuff doesn't need a perfect home. It needs a home I'll remember.
Want the zone system?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
